comments.body:
The abort looks like a real out-of-bounds access in `mock_components::GenericSystem` when `calculate_dynamics_` is enabled.

In `hardware_interface/src/mock_components/generic_system.cpp`, the dynamics branch stores state/command in:

- `std::array<double, 3> joint_state_values_` (pos/vel/acc)

…but later mirrors values back using `standard_interfaces_` (pos/vel/acc/effort). If the code iterates up to `standard_interfaces_.size()` (4) while indexing `joint_state_values_` (size 3), `std::array::operator[]` will hit `__n < this->size()` and abort (which matches your Resolute/libstdc++ assert).

On current `master`, this appears to be fixed by iterating up to `joint_state_values_.size()` instead (commit `dee3ca81a`). Cherry-picking that change into whatever branch/PR is running the Resolute CI should turn this into a normal test failure instead of a hard abort.
